metadata.title: SSPP – Secure Bare-Metal Platform
metadata.remarks: System Security & Privacy Plan asserting institutional requirements for secure, resilient, and governed bare‑metal execution environments.

import-profile.remarks: Imports institutional baseline security, governance, and resiliency requirements applicable to physical server infrastructure.

system-characteristics.system-description: Physical server platform providing trusted execution, hardware-backed isolation, and recoverable operation for institutional workloads and platform services that do not rely on a hypervisor abstraction layer.

props.name: platform-capability
props.remarks: This SSPP asserts secure and resilient execution directly on physical hardware as a foundational platform capability.

props.name: execution-scope
props.remarks: Bare‑metal servers may be dedicated or shared by policy, but always operate without virtualization isolation.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for cyber resiliency guidance related to identification of critical physical infrastructure, prevention of cascading failure, and recovery of execution environments under disruption.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for platform firmware resiliency guidance addressing BIOS, UEFI, BMC, and management firmware integrity, detection of compromise, and recovery to a known-good state. This guidance informs Secure Bare-Metal platform trust below the operating system, while cyber-resiliency intent is provided by NIST SP 800-184.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP asserts Secure Bare‑Metal execution by composition of platform server patterns. It defines no workload‑specific or application‑specific controls.

components.title: Secure Bare-Metal (Composite Assertion)
components.description: Composite assertion that physical servers provide trusted, observable, and recoverable execution.

roles.title: Bare-Metal Platform Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Defines institutional posture, risk tolerance, and resiliency expectations for physical server infrastructure.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: Bare-Metal Platform Architect
roles.remarks: Designs physical server architecture, trust anchors, recovery strategies, and dependencies with Secure-Networking and Secure-Time.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Architect per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Bare-Metal Platform Operations
roles.remarks: Operates physical servers, firmware lifecycle, secure boot, and recovery mechanisms in accordance with platform patterns.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Bare-Metal Security Monitoring and Assurance
roles.remarks: Monitors hardware and OS telemetry, detects integrity degradation, and supports incident response and recovery.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is achieved through inherited control implementations in Secure Server constituent patterns. This SSPP introduces no standalone or compensating controls.
